cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import itertools,time
from syntax import parse_policy
from ebpf.create_dfa import create
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
paths=[','.join((names[a],names[b])) for a in range(16) for b in range(16)]
text=''.join('match('+p+') allow;' for p in paths)*128
print(len(text))
t=time.time();p=parse_policy(text);print('parse',time.time()-t,p.atoms,p.path_symbols)
t=time.time();im=create(text,reg,p);print('create',time.time()-t,'rows',len(im['rows']),'acc',im['accept'],'cells',sum(x!=4294967295 for r in im['rows'] for x in r));print(im['rows'][0])
PY
